groups.name: Dark overlay on hero photo
groups.definition: Does the hero use a full-bleed photo background darkened by an overlay or gradient to keep text readable?

groups.name: Hero photo with baked-in text
groups.definition: Does the hero image contain text or seals baked into the picture itself?

groups.name: Candid people-centric photography
groups.definition: Does the page use photography of real people and everyday or lifestyle scenes rather than studio or stock art?

groups.name: Uniformly cropped thumbnails
groups.definition: Are thumbnails or gallery images cropped to a uniform aspect ratio or frame?

groups.name: Upscaled soft or distorted images
groups.definition: Are small source images upscaled or distorted beyond natural size so they look soft or stretched?

groups.name: Text baked into raster images
groups.definition: Are headings, labels, captions or controls delivered as text embedded in images instead of live HTML text?

groups.name: Rotated collage or multi-panel photos
groups.definition: Does the page present photos as a collage, scattered or multi-panel arrangement?

groups.name: Gradient overlay on flat tiles
groups.definition: Do promo or placeholder tiles use flat color fields with gradient overlays instead of photos?

groups.name: Monochrome logo row
groups.definition: Is there a row of grayscale or monochrome partner, press or payment logos?

groups.name: Logo tile grid with framing
groups.definition: Are sponsor or partner logos shown in tiles or rows with uniform or inconsistent framing, including combined badge images?

groups.name: Colored wash on photos
groups.definition: Are photos tinted with a colored wash or styled to match the brand palette?

groups.name: Mixed image styles
groups.definition: Does imagery mix illustration, clip-art, graphics and photos with inconsistent style?

groups.name: No inline SVG icons
groups.definition: Does the page avoid inline SVG icons, using text glyphs or raster images instead?

groups.name: Small inline SVG line icons
groups.definition: Are icons thin-stroke outline SVGs displayed at a uniform size?

groups.name: Very tall card images
groups.definition: Do cards use very tall images that dominate the page height?

groups.name: Hand-made illustrated graphics
groups.definition: Does the page use grainy, hand-drawn or decorative illustrations such as maps and line-art?

groups.name: Rounded hero photo with shadow
groups.definition: Does the hero photo have rounded corners and a soft drop shadow?

groups.name: Multicolored distinct-hue icons
groups.definition: Are icons flat illustrations each in a distinct color rather than one uniform set?

groups.name: Raster logo
groups.definition: Is the brand logo a raster image rather than SVG or live text?

groups.name: SVG wordmark with accent highlight
groups.definition: Is the logo an SVG wordmark with part highlighted in the accent color?

groups.name: Repeated logo placement
groups.definition: Does the brand logo appear repeatedly in header, mid-page and footer?

groups.name: Single saturated accent in photo
groups.definition: Does a single saturated accent color in the hero photo stand out against a muted palette?

groups.name: Descriptive alt text on images
groups.definition: Do images have descriptive alt text naming their content, organization or following a consistent pattern?

groups.name: Tiled hero strip clipping text
groups.definition: Is the hero a strip of equal tiles cropped from wider banners, clipping their text?

groups.name: Cut-out product photos on white
groups.definition: Are product photos isolated cut-outs on white without lifestyle context?

groups.name: Third-party banner ad inserted
groups.definition: Is a third-party banner advertisement inserted between content sections?

groups.name: Dark photo blending into dark panels
groups.definition: Does dark photography blend into adjoining dark panels, including a decorative full-width photo band?

groups.name: Placeholder video with play icon
groups.definition: Is a video placeholder shown as a rounded dark panel with a centered translucent play icon instead of real video?
